project.name: CheckTokenIsValid Lambda
project.description: A single AWS Lambda function, written in Java, that answers one question: "is this the correct secret token?" It reads the correct token from its own TOKEN environment variable (set in the Lambda console, not hardcoded) and compares it against whatever token it was invoked with. Deploys as a single "fat" .jar (via the Shade plugin below) uploaded directly to Lambda — no S3 bucket, no container image, no API Gateway involved. Called from labs/s3-v5-webapp/'s AuthFilter via the AWS SDK's LambdaClient, for the "AWS Lambda" session.
